semantics: customer.id / order.customer_id is the canonical analytical customer identity.
Customer purchase behavior is based on qualifying orders unless another population is explicitly requested.
Fully cancelled orders do not increase qualifying purchase count and do not reset customer recency.
Unique customer means a distinct non-null order.customer_id among the requested qualifying purchase population.
Repeat customer means a customer with at least two qualifying purchases in the relevant population/window.
For eligibility-plus-inactivity cohorts, calculate eligibility order count and latest qualifying order separately.
Do not restrict latest qualifying-order calculation to an eligibility-window lower bound when a more recent qualifying purchase could exist.
last N months / past N months means a rolling calendar-month lookback unless complete calendar months are explicitly requested.
Use opaque customer_id for model-facing aggregate calculations.
Customer PII is excluded from aggregate model context and may appear only in explicitly authorized local customer-record results.
PII-containing customer rows must bypass the Insight Analyst.
Reorder prediction uses customer_id + variant_id qualifying purchase history and is calculated deterministically by Rust.
